G-bear-backcountry-0001.name: By Sorcerer Creek
G-bear-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
G-bear-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on S87 Bachelor Ck. Rd. (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2006 (20 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2017 (fire N41369), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 23 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Sorcerer Creek 80 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle for Hunting Closed Area: Downie Creek. Closed April 1 to June 30 and September 1 to February 28 (February 29 in a leap year). Synopsis map 2-31/23.

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

Walk: 9.6 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 960 m, about 287 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 140 m SW of the spot at 1,276 m (51.45487, -117.98015). Water: Sorcerer Creek right here (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-38, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
